summary.text: On February 2, 2024, Gomez emphasized responsible AI implementation to balance consumer benefits and risks. Gomez described proposed political-advertising disclosures as informing audiences rather than banning AI-generated content, and supported exploring ways to inform consumers when communications are AI-generated. In December 2025, Gomez questioned the FCC's authority to preempt state AI laws without a comprehensive federal framework granting that authority. In January 2026, Gomez argued that AI leadership and related investments should be judged by people's ability to connect, participate, and benefit, rather than infrastructure construction alone.
